abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.text: When IG-88 declares an attack targeting a figure within 3 spaces, that figure suffers 1 {C}.

abilities.name: Assault
abilities.text: IG-88 can perform multiple attacks each activation.

abilities.name: Arsenal
abilities.text: Your attack pool consists of any combination of 2 attack dice.

abilities.name: {A} Brutality
abilities.text: Perform 2 attacks. Each attack must have a different target.

abilities.name: {A} Force Choke
abilities.text: Choose a hostile figure in your line of sight. That figure suffers 2 {H} and 1 {C}.

abilities.name: Foresight
abilities.text: While defending, you may reroll 1 defense die.

abilities.name: {A} General's Orders
abilities.text: Choose up to 2 other friendly figures on the map. Those figures may each interrupt to perform a move.

abilities.name: Epic Arsenal
abilities.text: Your attack pool consists of any combination of 3 attack dice. You may not roll more than 2 dice of a single color.

abilities.name: {A} Brutality
abilities.text: Perform 2 attacks. Each attack must have a different target.

abilities.name: Executor
abilities.text: When a friendly figure within 3 spaces is defeated, this figure may interrupt to move up to 2 spaces and then perform an attack. Limit once per round.

abilities.name: {A} Firing Squad
abilities.text: Choose up to 2 adjacent friendly TROOPERS. Each of those figures may interrupt to perform an attack targeting the same figure.

abilities.name: {B} Squad Command
abilities.text: Choose an adjacent friendly TROOPER. That figure becomes Focused.

abilities.name: Battle Presence
abilities.text: After a hostile figure voluntarily exits a space adjacent to Boba Fett, that figure suffers 1 {C}. Limit once per figure per round.

abilities.name: Battle Discipline
abilities.text: When you declare an attack, choose 1 of the following abilities to apply to that attack: +2 Accuracy | {B}: +2 {H} | {B}: Recover 2 {H}.

abilities.name: Contempt
abilities.text: While attacking, if the target does not have a HARMFUL condition, Dengar applies +1 {B} to the attack results.

abilities.name: {B} Punishment
abilities.text: After the attack resolves, if the target suffered 1 or more {H}, choose 1 HARMFUL condition. The target gains that condition. This ability can be triggered multiple times in the same attack.

abilities.name: Advanced Firepower
abilities.text: Adjacent friendly DROIDS and VEHICLES can use General Sorin's surge abilities.

abilities.name: {A} Bombardment
abilities.text: Choose an adjacent friendly figure. That figure may interrupt to perform an attack. The attack gains Blast 1 {H}.

abilities.name: {A} Activate Agent
abilities.text: Resolve an optional deployment. During this deployment, reduce the deployment cost of SPY and TROOPER groups by 1.

abilities.name: {B} Menace
abilities.text: Increase threat by 1.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.text: At the end of each round, Bossk recovers 2 {H} and discards all HARMFUL conditions.

abilities.name: {A} Indiscriminate Fire
abilities.text: Choose a space within 3 spaces and in your line of sight. Then, roll 1 green die. Each figure on or adjacent to that space suffers {H} equal to the {H} results and {C} equal to the {C} results.

abilities.name: {A} Bully
abilities.text: A figure of your choice within 3 spaces suffers 3 {C}.

abilities.name: {A} Execution Order
abilities.text: Another EXECUTOR figure of your choice may interrupt to perform an attack.

abilities.name: {A} Financial Incentive
abilities.text: A friendly figure of your choice recovers 2 {H} and becomes Focused.

abilities.name: {A} Plot
abilities.text: Increase threat by 2.

abilities.name: Hutt Syndicate
abilities.text: If you are on the map at the end of the mission, the Imperial player may gain 1 influence.

abilities.name: {A} Flamethrower
abilities.text: Choose a space within 2 spaces. Each other figure on or adjacent to that space suffers 1 {H} and 1 {C}, then becomes Weakened.

abilities.name: Mounted
abilities.text: At the start of your activation, gain 3 movement points.

abilities.name: Emperor
abilities.text: Once during your activation, you may choose another figure within 4 spaces. That figure interrupts to perform an attack.

abilities.name: Tempt
abilities.text: At the start of your activation, a figure of your choice suffers 1 {H} and gains 1 damage token.

abilities.name: {A} Force Lightning
abilities.text: Choose a figure within 4 spaces and line of sight. That figure suffers 3 {H} and becomes Weakened. Each figure adjacent to that figure suffers 1 {H}.

abilities.name: Sustained by Rage
abilities.text: Maul cannot recover {H}. If Maul has not resolved an activation this round, he cannot be defeated.

abilities.name: Dual-Bladed Fury
abilities.text: Before you declare an attack, choose one: This attack gains Reach and Cleave 2 {H} or you become Focused.

abilities.name: {B} Stalk Prey
abilities.text: After this attack resolves, you gain 2 movement points and 1 damage token.

abilities.name: Prediction
abilities.text: At the start of each round, choose 1 hero. If it is the first hero to activate this round, it becomes Stunned.

abilities.name: Patience
abilities.text: When you activate a group, you may distribute wild tokens equal to the number of exhausted Rebel activation tokens among its figures, each figure a different token. Limit once per round.

abilities.name: Negotiate
abilities.text: When you declare an attack, the heroes must choose one: Increase threat by 2 or apply +2 {H} to the attack results.

abilities.name: Ulterior Motive
abilities.text: When you enter a space containing a crate, increase threat by 2. Limit once per crate.

abilities.name: Defensive
abilities.text: While defending, if the Grand Inquisitor did not roll a {G} result, apply +1 {G} to the defense results.

abilities.name: {A} Lightsaber Throw
abilities.text: Perform a {O} attack using 1 red and 1 yellow die. Apply +3 Accuracy to the attack results.

abilities.name: Unnerving
abilities.text: At the end of 0-0-0's activation, each adjacent hostile figure becomes Weakened.

abilities.name: {B} Shocking Palm
abilities.text: The attack misses and the defender becomes Stunned.

abilities.name: {A} Invasive Procedure
abilities.text: An adjacent figure suffers 1 {H}, 1 {C}, and becomes Bleeding. You become Focused.

abilities.name: Assassin
abilities.text: Before BT-1 declares an attack, he becomes Focused.

abilities.name: {A} Missile Salvo
abilities.text: Perform up to 3 {O} attacks with different targets using 1 blue, 1 red, or 1 yellow die. Limit once per die. Apply +3 Accuracy to each of these attacks.

abilities.name: Slow on the Draw
abilities.text: When Greedo declares an attack, the target may interrupt to perform an attack targeting Greedo.

abilities.name: Parting Shot
abilities.text: When you have suffered {H} equal to your Health, before you are defeated, you may interrupt to perform an attack. Then, you are defeated.
